map.按分隔符拆行：把一行「a,b,c」拆成三行，便于逐条处理。: Split a line by delimiter: break "a,b,c" into three lines for per-item processing.
map.分列：按逗号/制表符把一行拆成多列，做表格源。: Split into columns: break a line by comma/tab into multiple columns as a table source.
map.定长切分：把长串按固定长度切块，处理协议或编码数据。: Fixed-length chunking: cut a long string into fixed-length blocks for protocol or encoding data.
